text_block_list.text:
Days of grueling,
relentless training. The 
two experienced hell—yet their 
preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a rival, she will defeat Smart Falcon 
and outshine her completely.
Having broken 
through her limits, she enters the 
Kawasaki Kinen—and it's about to begin!
